title: Loop structures and operation counts
summary: Compare how workload grows across a single operation, a single loop, and a nested two-level loop.
description: Each small square represents 1 elementary operation, and each surrounding loop box indicates the scope repeated.

frames.title: Loop structures and operation counts
frames.explanation: A double enclosure represents nesting: for every 1 iteration of the outer loop, the inner loop runs all n iterations in full, so the counts multiply to n × n rather than adding as they would for two sequential loops.

tables.caption: Workloads across loop structures
rows: Two nested loops of n iterations each
